fire: Treacher Collins syndrome is a rare facial disorder. Doctors use several surgeries to treat the symptoms of Treacher Collins syndrome.
Saethre-Chotzen syndrome is a rare skull condition. Surgeons often operate early to ease the symptoms of Saethre-Chotzen syndrome.
Naegleria fowleri is a rare brain amoeba. Most infections with Naegleria fowleri come from swimming in warm lakes.
Kabuki syndrome is a rare genetic disorder. Several therapies can reduce the symptoms of Kabuki syndrome in young children.
Ehlers-Danlos syndrome weakens connective tissue. Physiotherapy helps with many of the symptoms of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome.
Acanthamoeba keratitis is a rare eye infection. Contact lens wearers face the highest risk of Acanthamoeba keratitis.
Pyle disease is a rare bone disorder. Doctors still know very little about the causes of Pyle disease.
Goldenhar syndrome affects the face and spine. Doctors use several surgeries to treat the symptoms of Goldenhar syndrome.
